def rotl8(x: uint8, k: int) -> uint8:
    """Rotate x left by k bits (0 <= k <= 7); the high bits wrap around to the low end."""
    pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
    post k != 0 or out == x
    ex rotl8(1, 0) == 1
    ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
    ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
    ex rotl8(255, 3) == 255
    ex rotl8(150, 4) == 105
    low = (x & (255 >> k)) << k
    high = x >> 1 >> (7 - k)
    return low | high
